misprints.note: Accent printed on the second syllable.
The print shows ι where τ belongs; compare κτυπεῖν under Braka.
No rough breathing on the article in the print.
Circumflex printed where the accusative plural takes an acute.

uncertain.note: The line breaks after '(ἐξ)-'. I took the hyphen as a line-end break and joined the word without it, but it may be a real prefix hyphen ('(ἐξ)-ἀκριβοῦν').
There is a small mark over the omega that may be an acute next to the rough breathing (ὥς). I chose ὡς.
In the print the accent and breathing of 'ραγμος, ο.' have slipped down to sit under the line above. I restored them in place.
Only a colon is visible, at the end of the line with a space before it. The usual '.:' may have lost its full stop.
The 'ä' is blotted or broken type in the scan.
In the print 'το πυρ.' has its grave and circumflex displaced to the line above. I restored them in place.
